headline.purpose: Timeline coordinate, not a marketing eyebrow.

body.purpose: Era support lines and future prompt.

motion.name: ease-cinematic
motion.purpose: GSAP pin morphs and showcase transitions.

components.name: Museum nav
components.description: Sticky era rail. Recedes on NEXT.
components.css: .ds-museum-nav { display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; background:#050505eb; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding:0.35rem 0.75rem; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.14em; color:#e8e4d9;} .ds-brand { color:#e8e4d9; text-decoration:none; letter-spacing:0.32em;} .ds-era { color:#d4d0c4; text-decoration:none;} .ds-era.is-active { color:#e8e4d9;} .ds-era.is-active::before { content:''; display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; margin-right:8px; border-radius:50%; background:#d4782a;}

components.name: Generated mode
components.description: Square ghost control for Place / Orbit / Dissolve.
components.css: .ds-mode { min-height:2.75rem; padding:0.45rem 0.9rem; border:1px solid #3a3229; background:transparent; color:#ece7dc; font-family:ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:0.72rem; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase;} .ds-mode[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color:#d4782a; color:#d4782a;}

narrative.overview: NET//HISTORY is a one-page museum whose visual language mutates with the timeline. Shared chrome is the building; each era is a gallery with its own materials. The product fails if those galleries collapse into one modern system.
keyCharacteristics: Museum chrome stays minimal and recedes
Two museum faces: IBM Plex Mono and Geist

rules.name: The Mutation Rule
rules.body: One accent for the building. A new accent for each gallery.

rules.name: The Flat Chrome Rule
rules.body: Museum nav does not grow glass, blur, or drop shadows.

dos: Do let each era keep its own chrome, type, and density.
Do land era jumps on the pinned scene.
Do keep reduced-motion final states readable.
donts: Don't restyle 1995/1999 into modern cards or glass.
Don't hide 2018 satire or 2023 outputs until the end of a long pin.
Don't cover story copy with the rail.
